weakness: No account procedure, approvals, reviews, or monitoring; shared counter, packaging, and delivery app logins
remediation_plan: Onboarding and termination checklist covering PMS, suite, fax portal, delivery app, and MSP tool; monthly account reconciliation; named driver login on the paid delivery app plan
milestones: 2026-09-30 checklist in use; 2026-10-31 first monthly reconciliation and named driver login
resources_required: Store Manager time (1 hour a month)

weakness: No time limit for disabling access; MFA registrations and shared passwords not changed; no exit reminder of confidentiality
remediation_plan: Last-day checklist (same as POAM-001) including MFA removal, shared password and alarm code changes, and a signed confidentiality reminder

weakness: Shared counter desktop account has local administrator rights; PMS administrator role used for daily work
remediation_plan: Individual standard desktop accounts without administrator rights; separate PMS administrator sign-in used only for administration; controlled substance alteration limited to pharmacists (done 2026-07-17); quarterly role check
milestones: 2026-07-17 controlled substance permission fixed; 2026-10-31 individual desktop accounts and separate administrator sign-in

weakness: Daily EPCS audit report not reviewed consistently; no access review; no path for the one-business-day report
remediation_plan: Pharmacist on duty reviews the EPCS report each business day and initials the log; POL-03 4.6 reporting steps; Store Manager reviews PMS access reports and suite sign-in alerts monthly; pharmacist-owner checks the EPCS log monthly
milestones: 2026-09-01 daily log in use; 2026-09-30 first monthly access review and first owner check
resources_required: Pharmacist time (about 5 minutes a business day)

weakness: Backup console and in-store PMS administrator sign-in accept a password only
remediation_plan: MSP enables MFA on the backup console and sends a screenshot; PMS vendor enables its in-store second-factor option for all users, starting with administrators
milestones: 2026-09-15 backup console MFA; 2026-12-31 in-store PMS second factor
resources_required: MSP labor (included in contract); PMS vendor setting

weakness: No protection on the packaging workstation; antivirus alerts reach the MSP only in business hours; no behavior-based detection
remediation_plan: MSP-managed EDR with alert monitoring on the 7 computers; alerts to the Store Manager by text; packaging workstation isolated on its own segment (POAM-014)

weakness: Backups not immutable; 30-day versions; console password only; security records on paper only
remediation_plan: 90-day versioning with immutable retention; MFA on the console (POAM-005); scan the BAA folder and designation letter into the shared drive; MSP confirms the firewall configuration backup
milestones: 2026-09-15 console MFA; 2026-09-30 records scanned; 2026-10-31 backup upgraded

weakness: No contingency plan testing; backups never restore-tested
remediation_plan: MSP restores a shared-drive folder and rebuilds the packaging workstation from its image; quarterly restore tests recorded; annual tabletop using the P08 runbook
milestones: 2026-09-30 first restore test; 2026-11-30 tabletop; 2026-12-31 second restore test

weakness: Security training missing; privacy video only at hire; no reminders or phishing exercises
remediation_plan: Annual online training; quarterly phishing simulations; monthly reminder at the staff huddle; EPCS, PDMP, and CSOS module for pharmacists; the March 2026 misdirected fax used as a case

weakness: Two vendors handle ePHI without a BAA; packaging vendor connects at will; no vendor oversight; backup subcontractor BAA unconfirmed
remediation_plan: BAA on a paid delivery app plan or a replacement app; BAA with the packaging equipment vendor and sessions only on request with a log; MSP confirms the backup subcontractor BAA; annual MSP security review
milestones: 2026-10-31 both BAAs and subcontractor confirmation; 2026-12-31 MSP review
resources_required: About $480 a year (delivery app); owner and Store Manager time

weakness: 5 desktops unencrypted, with downloaded faxes in download folders
remediation_plan: MSP enables full-disk encryption on all 5 desktops and reports status monthly; weekly download folder clean-up; packaging workstation encrypted at the next equipment refresh

weakness: Staff not told how and when to report incidents
remediation_plan: Reporting rule (POL-03 4.2) on a card at every station with after-hours numbers; covered in annual training

weakness: Risk assessment never updated (first analysis in 2026)
remediation_plan: Annual update each July under POL-02 A.2

weakness: Packaging workstation runs an unsupported operating system, excluded from patching without the pharmacy's approval; no update time limits; firmware tests not recorded
source: P07 test; P01 R-008; P04 finding 1
remediation_plan: Separate network segment for the packaging workstation; written approval for any patch exclusion; 14-day limit for critical updates in the MSP contract; supported controller at the next equipment refresh written into the service contract; firmware test records
milestones: 2026-10-31 exclusion approved in writing and contract terms; 2026-12-31 segment in place

weakness: Same local administrator password on every computer; Wi-Fi and vendor passwords unchanged; 8-character PMS passwords; no procedure for compromised authenticators
source: P07 test 2026-08-05 (new finding); P01 R-023, R-014
remediation_plan: MSP sets unique, rotated local administrator passwords with its password management tool; equipment vendor changes the packaging password; Wi-Fi password changed; PMS minimum 12 characters; compromised-authenticator steps in POL-03 (CSOS password no longer saved since 2026-07-17)
milestones: 2026-09-15 local administrator passwords; 2026-09-30 Wi-Fi, PMS, and packaging passwords
